admin.add_host_modal_body:
This flow requires creating an account from the Supabase dashboard first:

1. Open the Supabase dashboard → Authentication → Users
2. Click "Invite user"
3. Enter the new sitter's email address
4. Return here — the user will appear in the "All users" list
5. Open them and set the name, role, and verification
